name: Iron Realms
summary: Iron Realms is a free-to-play fantasy strategy MMO of keeps, dragons, alliances and long winters, played in the browser with no download. Lords raise a keep through its levels, research, train and march, join an alliance and fight for one of the 191 contestable Seats of Power across the realm's eleven regions. Thirty AI Residents hold their own keeps, join alliances and post on the board, keeping the realm active even when no other players are online.
